## 🚀 HIGH-IMPACT FEATURES (Must-Have Next)

### 1️⃣ Text Effects (Big Visual Upgrade)

Add **professional typography controls**:

* Shadow (X, Y, blur, opacity)
* Stroke (outline text)
* Background highlight (pill / box behind text)
* Line height & letter spacing

👉 Makes thumbnails instantly “YouTube-ready”

---

### 2️⃣ Font Library + Google Fonts

* 10–20 popular fonts (Poppins, Bebas Neue, Montserrat, Anton)

👉 Interviewers LOVE font handling

---

### 3️⃣ Canvas Presets (Creator-Focused)

Add preset sizes:

* Instagram Post (1:1)

* Twitter / LinkedIn post

👉 This makes it usable, not just technical

---

### 4️⃣ Layer Panel (Mini Photoshop)

Add a **Layers tab**:

👉 Shows strong UI/UX thinking
